text:
anya (PM): quick sync — we need to finalize auth model for multi-project customers. proposal: project-scoped api keys + org admin keys, plus explicit rotation endpoints. want tradeoffs, launch criteria, and any blocker risks. :eyes:
sam (eng): sounds sane. main engineering cost is routing + billing mapping when requests arrive with project-scoped keys. also need backwards compatibility for existing org keys.
lina (security): must support short-lived ephemeral keys for high-risk ops and rotation webhooks. we should require kms-backed secrets for private deployments. audit logs are a must.
mike (solutions): customers repeatedly ask for delegated keys for contractors and third-party integrators — they want granular scopes per project and ability to revoke per-integration. also migration path from org->project keys is common ask.
chester (eng-infra): technical notes: 1) enforce key->project mapping at edge (LB) to avoid extra hops; 2) add header X-Project-ID fallback for older keys during migration; 3) rack of metrics per key type for cost attribution.
anya (PM): good context. can we draft minimal launch checklist? propose: project-scoped keys GA, rotation API (POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate), revoke API, audit trail retention 90d, SDK updates, docs + migration helper.
sam (eng): implementation concerns: rotation API needs zero-downtime swap + ability to return new key material once; also opt-in forced rotation policy for org admins. complexity: key caching on serving nodes — need eviction mechanics.
lina (security): acceptance criteria from security POV: 1) rotation endpoint requires admin role or kms-signed request; 2) audit entry for every rotate/revoke; 3) ephemeral token TTL defaults to 1h and max 24h; 4) HSM/KMS support documented.
mike (solutions): commercial asks to prioritize: delegated scopes (read/write/invoke), per-key rate-limits, and per-project usage reporting. if we can't ship all, prioritize delegation + revoke.
anya (PM): prioritization vote: (a) project keys + revoke + basic rotation API, (b) delegated scopes + per-key rate-limits, (c) migration helper + advanced rotation policies. thumbs?
chester (eng-infra): +1 for (a) then (b). (a) is highest infra ROI.
sam (eng): +1 (a) but we need a clear fallback plan: if project-id missing, treat as org legacy key and emit deprecation header.
lina (security): +1 (a), defer advanced rotation to next milestone.
mike (solutions): +1 (a) but we must ship docs + sample migration script with the GA.
anya (PM): agreed. i'll write PRD with launch criteria. draft acceptance checklist below — please comment inline if anything missing:
- product: project-scoped API keys (create/list/revoke) :white_check_mark:
- infra: routing by key -> project enforced at edge :white_check_mark:
- security: rotation endpoint + audit events :white_check_mark:
- docs: migration guide and SDK examples (rotate, revoke) :white_check_mark:
- metrics: per-key usage and per-project billing tags :white_check_mark:
- gating: integration tests + canary with 2 pilot customers :white_check_mark:

sam (eng): two additional dev tasks: 1) key cache eviction hook TTL aligned with rotation; 2) add deprecation header `X-Auth-Deprecation: project-keys` for org keys that need migration.
lina (security): also require that rotation creates an immutable audit id returned in response, e.g. `audit_id: zxy-...`, for compliance lookups.
mike (solutions): i'll line up pilot customers and draft migration script; will need eng support for canary traffic shaping.
anya (PM): timeline proposal: week 0-2 design + infra spike, week 3-6 build, week 7 canary, week 8 GA. objections?
chester (eng-infra): feasible but we must reserve a 2-day buffer for rollback automation in week 7.
sam (eng): ok. i'll add detailed tasks in the sprint.
anya (PM): thanks — i'll post the PRD and assign follow-ups. tagging security + infra owners for reviews. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: scheduled canary window created for 1869072000 - 1869158400 for product/project-key-canary :rocket:
anya (PM): concluding note — rollout policy: default to blocking for new org keys after 60 days of deprecation notice, but not auto-rotate org keys to project keys. we need opt-in migration + explicit admin action.
lina (security): fine, but require org-level admins to sign rotation consent via audit flow for bulk migrations.
anya (PM): noted. i'll include in PRD. end.
